answer: Re-attestations are stored in bridge and thread lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the timber graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1826 impostors cost 752 times the honest price and take 17 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
